en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5594 - Al-Abbas ibn Amir narrated from Abu Al-Sahari, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who bought a house, and there remained an empty plot of land. He built upon it a house to generate income. Should he endow it for the mosque?
Imam (as) replied: "Indeed, the Magians endowed property for their fire temples."
